claims.statement: OCPP 2.0.1 exposes transaction events, meter values, offline indicators, stop reasons, and charger status needed for independent event reconstruction.
Demand hypothesis: financed multi-vendor fleets will pay for neutral monthly settlement when operational logs can directly test contractual service levels.

contrary_evidence: Charge-management systems already expose uptime dashboards.
Many contracts may not contain financially meaningful SLA credits.

economics.acquisition_route: Sell one API integration to a charge-management or leasing partner serving many sites.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 25000 connectors at 12 PLN monthly plus recovery fees can create 4 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in five years.
economics.founder_time: Three to four hours daily for integrations and exception support.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 85-92% margin after automated ingestion and calculation.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 4000 connectors at 12 PLN monthly repay initial capital within fifteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 8-20 PLN per connector monthly plus 10% of recovered credits.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every connector generates continuous events and monthly settlement checks.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Cross-vendor failure and settlement data create unique reliability benchmarks.
fingerprint.customer: Fleet depots, landlords, charge-point operators, and charger financiers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Charge-management vendors, installers, and leasing firms embed it as independent assurance.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: The service ingests OCPP events, applies contract rules, and issues a signed settlement statement.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The asset owner pays per connector monthly and optionally a share of recovered credits.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A charger outage or interrupted session creates an SLA, warranty, or invoice dispute across operator and hardware logs.

founder_fit: The technical integration matches data-engineering strengths.
Renewable installer relationships can surface early charger customers.
risks: Missing events could undermine neutral calculations.
Operators may dispute an external interpretation of contract terms.

structure.control_point: The accepted connector-event and credit calculation ledger.
structure.critical_dependency: Complete OCPP feeds and machine-readable SLA terms.

thesis: A neutral event ledger can calculate charger uptime, interrupted sessions, and contract credits across mixed hardware fleets.
title: EV Charger SLA Settlement Rail
uncertainties: Channel partners' appetite for independent assurance is unverified.
